description: eSIM Finder helps travellers find and compare prepaid travel eSIM data plans for 190+ countries and regions — without leaving the chat. Tell it your destination and trip length and it searches live plans, compares data allowances and prices in 40 currencies, explains the plan types, and gives you a link to the plan you choose. It also offers an Annual Travel Pass — one reusable data-only eSIM covering ~130 countries for 12 months. The connector is read-only and anonymous: no account, no sign-up, and it never sees your name, email, or conversation history. Purchases are completed on the provider's secure store; eSIM Finder takes no payments.

defaultPrompt: I want just one eSIM for one year
